costBobDb.detail: Read (read-only) from Bob’s local database (`~/.bob/db/bob.db`), subagents included: Bob doesn’t send it over ACP.

subagentCost.detail: Read again from the same database every 2 s while a subagent works, shown on its card.

subagentCalls.label: Recognized subagents

testedVersions.label: Checked versions
testedVersions.detail: {{versions}}; a newer or older version is flagged once in the conversation, any other in Diagnostics.

subagentReplay.label: Subagents’ work
subagentReplay.detail: {{agent}} keeps each subagent’s session: “View its work” replays it separately (`session/load`), without calling the model.

subagentLive.label: Subagents’ work, live
subagentLive.detail: {{agent}} relays its subagents’ work in the conversation’s stream (`_meta["opencode/child-session"]`, since OpenCode 2): the app files it under the subagent’s card instead of mixing it into the thread.

subagentBackground.label: Background subagents followed until they end
subagentBackground.detail: When {{agent}} starts a subagent in the background, its tool returns right away (`metadata.status: "running"`): the app keeps it “running”, rereads its session from time to time, and shows it done with its answer when it ends.

executeErrors.label: Errors of tools called from code
executeErrors.detail: When {{agent}} calls tools through its `execute` tool, it says the card finished even if one of them failed; the app reads the error it notes separately (`rawOutput.metadata.toolCalls`) and marks the card failed.

agentLog.label: Agent log
agentLog.detail: {{agent}} writes its own log in `{{path}}` (one file per launch). With Settings › Diagnostics › Log set to Trace, it logs in full detail.

startMode.label: Starting mode on open
startMode.detail: A new conversation asks for its starting mode (Plan…) as soon as the session opens, in `{{key}}`: {{agent}} starts straight in that mode, with no mode switch right after.

replayDiffs.label: Changes recovered on reopen
replayDiffs.detail: When {{agent}} reopens a conversation, it no longer attaches a change’s diff if the file has changed since: the app rebuilds it from the patch the tool kept (`rawOutput.metadata.files`), so the Changes tab stays complete.

childModel.label: Child conversation model
childModel.detail: The parent conversation can suggest a {{agent}} model for a child, with its reason; you confirm or change it before it starts.

hiddenEmptySessions.label: Empty sessions hidden
hiddenEmptySessions.detail: “Resume a session…” doesn’t show sessions that were never written to, which {{agent}} keeps under a default title.

alwaysScope.label: Scope of “Always”
alwaysScope.detail: On a permission card, “Always in this conversation” says that {{agent}} remembers the choice until the end of the conversation (a command and each of its parts, every file change). Without this declaration, the card only says that the agent decides.

compactCommand.label: Compaction
compactCommand.detail: `{{command}}` is in the “/” list even though the agent doesn’t announce it; `/compact` works too.

rulesFiles.label: Active rules listed
rulesFiles.bob: The folder’s `AGENTS.md`, `.bob/rules/` and `.bob/rules-<mode>/` in the folder and in `~/.bob` (plugins included), as Bob reads them.
rulesFiles.opencode: `~/.config/opencode/AGENTS.md`, the `AGENTS.md` files from the folder up to the home folder (outside it: up to the repository root) and the `instructions` key, as OpenCode 2 reads them; with OpenCode 1, up to the repository root, falling back to `CLAUDE.md`.

approvalRules.label: Bob IDE and Bob Shell approval rules
approvalRules.bob: `~/.bob/settings/settings.json` (`approval` section): commands allowed and denied everywhere, groups approved for all tasks, access outside the folder. Read and written like Bob IDE does, only when you ask; they apply in Bob IDE and Bob Shell, and from the next conversation.

rolesSettings.intro: Specialized agents, called with @ or chosen by the agent. Each one works in a child conversation.

builtinDescription.uxUiExpert: Designs or reviews user interfaces: layout, hierarchy, wording, accessibility, consistency with the existing design system.
builtinDescription.flutterExpert: Builds or fixes Flutter and Dart code: widgets, state management, platform channels, tests.
builtinDescription.frontArchitect: Shapes the front-end architecture: component boundaries, state and data flow, performance, build and dependencies.
builtinDescription.backArchitect: Shapes the back-end architecture: APIs, data model and migrations, consistency, scalability, failure handling.
builtinDescription.securityExpert: Audits the security of a change or a module (injection, secrets, authentication, permissions, dependencies). Changes nothing.
builtinDescription.techLead: Plans and reviews like a demanding tech lead: splits work, spots risks, checks robustness and maintainability. Changes nothing.
builtinDescription.codeReviewer: Reviews a change before merge: correctness, tests, readability, conventions of the project. Changes nothing.
